text:
Sam K: Keeper league question — can a player we just traded in still be a keeper for next year? trade went through last night and the other owner says yes.
Priya M: Rules doc says "keeper must be on your roster by the start of week 1" but we amended that once. lemme check the pinned thread.
Marco: I thought we had a trade-freeze for keepers: if traded after week 10 they're ineligible? not 100% sure.
Jen L: We never enforced a strict cutoff before, usually it's 'own before playoffs start'.
Alex: My memory is: you must have owned them for at least 4 weeks before rosters lock for keepers. (could be wrong)
Dana: This whole league has one mod who remembers the rules :sweat_smile:. @Elliot you wrote the keeper rules last year, right?
Elliot: I wrote the draft rules, yes. Keeper-specific we left loose. Happy to call a quick vote — proposal: if player was acquired after week 14 they're not keeper-eligible.
Sam K: Trade was completed at 1988012338 (last night), which is week 15. so by that proposal, not eligible.
Priya M: Can we do a retro rule change? feels sketchy to change rules after a trade.
Marco: Agreed. Can't change mid-season to void someone else's move.
Jen L: Suggestion: offer a compensatory pick instead of keeper — like the buyer gets a 3rd-round pick next year in place of keeping that player.
Alex: I'm for compensatory pick. Keeps things fair and avoids veto drama.
Dana: Vote: +1 compensatory pick
Elliot: Vote recorded: +1 comp pick. @leaguebot can you add a note in the league channel and set comp pick at round 3?
leaguebot: Recorded vote from Elliot. Rule update proposal: compensatory pick (round 3) if traded into roster after week 14. Pending majority.
Sam K: Thank you everyone. Not ideal but better than full veto. I'll DM the owner who traded for it and propose the comp pick.
Priya M: Thanks Sam. Also, can someone remind me when keeper declarations are due? I have three players I might keep.
Marco: June 2 is the deadline last year. I'll confirm and post in league channel.
Jen L: Also can we set a permanent rule next season so we stop guessing midweek? :pray:
Alex: Agreed. Put it in writing early.
Dana: :thumbsup:
leaguebot: Posted updated proposal in #fantasy-general with a poll. Poll: Accept compensatory pick (round 3) — yes/no. Voting open for 48 hours.
